parameter.zero_meaning: expresses nothing in EVERY state, the unventilated boundary included: decided before the PaCO2 is read, so it is the same as the link not being declared

hypoventilation_oxygenation_transmission: UNSCALED (PHASE2_AMENDMENT_1): the share of the common relative alveolar link that is EXPRESSED, delta_PaO2 = fraction x (-delta_PaCO2 / R); None by default, which reproduces the certified P2T-5 full transmission bit for bit, 0 transmits nothing and 1 is that full transmission. It controls how much the RELATIVE alveolar-gas link is expressed and is NOT a respiratory quotient, a shunt fraction, an FiO2 gain, a G retention, a mechanics efficiency or a central availability; it never multiplies retained(G) and has no direct effect on RR, W, PaCO2, the drive, L or the tone. Declared only with the link it scales; no value is approved
